seo.metaTitle: PDF metadata stripper — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Strip hidden /Author, /Creator, /Producer, /CreationDate, /ModDate, and XMP XML packets from PDF files before public release or legal filing. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/pdf/pdf-metadata-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: PDF metadata stripper processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/pdf/pdf-metadata-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does PDF metadata stripper upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. PDF metadata stripper executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/pdf/pdf-metadata-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does PDF metadata stripper upload my files or text to a server?

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate PDF metadata stripper?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/pdf_metadata.json or open /tools/pdf-metadata?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
